activities.body: Kickoff with Halden & Roe. Marta Okonjo (Head of Delivery) was named as the person who signs off each release of the agent before it reaches their staff.
Note taken by Ines Bardem on the delivery call: release sign-off has moved to Tomas Brandt (Platform Lead), 'per Marta'.
Forwarded message from Marta Okonjo's office: release sign-off remains with Marta until the platform team is fully staffed, and Tomas Brandt is not authorised to approve releases in the interim.
A release reached Halden & Roe staff after being marked approved in their own ticket system. The ticket records no approver name.
Quarterly check-in with Marta Okonjo and Tomas Brandt. Delivery is on track. Release sign-off was not discussed.
